business_summary: Commvault Systems, Inc. provides cyber resiliency solutions for enterprises to protect, secure, and recover data, applications, and identity system. The company offers Operational Recovery for backup and recovery capabilities in hybrid enterprise workloads, such as backup, restore, recovery validation, and policy-based data movement to cloud storage; Autonomous Recovery, which adds automation, orchestration, and validation intended to reduce recovery times, downtime, and operational complexity; and Cyber Recovery, which adds cyber preparedness, threat detection, and clean recovery features to help organizations respond to ransomware and other cyber incidents. The company also provides Commvault Cleanroom Recovery, an isolated and on-demand recovery environment in the cloud; Commvault HyperScale Grid, an integrated and scale-out data protection solution; Commvault HyperScale Flex, a data protection solution designed to support enterprise-scale environments and large-volume data workloads; and Commvault Threatscan to help identify and isolate malicious or anomalous data within backup environments. In addition, it offers Commvault Cloud Air Gap Protect for isolated cloud storage; Commvault's Compliance, which includes reporting, auditing, and logging; Commvault's Cloud Rewind for data recovery with automated cloud application and infrastructure rebuild capabilities; and Commvault's Clumio Backtrack to revert cloud objects and datasets to a prior point in time. Further, the company provides professional and customer support services comprising real-time support, support engineers, customer success options, technology consulting services, recovery services, education services, and cyber resilience managed services. It operates in the United States, Canada, and Latin America, as well as in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, India, Southeast Asia, and China. Commvault Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tinton Falls, New Jersey.
business_summary_ko: Commvault Systems, Inc.는 기업이 데이터, 애플리케이션 및 ID 시스템을 보호, 보호 및 복구할 수 있는 사이버 탄력성 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 백업, 복원, 복구 검증, 클라우드 스토리지로의 정책 기반 데이터 이동과 같은 하이브리드 엔터프라이즈 워크로드의 백업 및 복구 기능을 위한 운영 복구를 제공합니다. 복구 시간, 가동 중지 시간 및 운영 복잡성을 줄이기 위해 자동화, 조정 및 검증을 추가하는 자율 복구 사이버 복구(Cyber ​​Recovery)는 조직이 랜섬웨어 및 기타 사이버 사고에 대응할 수 있도록 사이버 준비, 위협 탐지 및 완전한 복구 기능을 추가합니다. 또한 이 회사는 클라우드에서 격리된 주문형 복구 환경인 Commvault Cleanroom Recovery를 제공합니다. 통합 및 확장형 데이터 보호 솔루션인 Commvault HyperScale Grid; 엔터프라이즈 규모의 환경과 대용량 데이터 워크로드를 지원하도록 설계된 데이터 보호 솔루션인 Commvault HyperScale Flex 및 Commvault Threatscan을 사용하여 백업 환경 내에서 악성 또는 변칙 데이터를 식별하고 격리할 수 있습니다. 또한 격리된 클라우드 스토리지를 위한 Commvault Cloud Air Gap Protect를 제공합니다. 통신
